# PDF smoke fixtures

Pinned fixtures for `web/pdf/test/smoke-node.mjs`. Each `*-reference.txt` is
the extracted PDF text (`pdftotext`, run on the host) of a document compiled
**natively** with Tectonic; the browser engine's output must match it
byte for byte (ADR0017/ADR0019 fitness functions). Regenerating a reference
is a deliberate, auditable act: rerun the commands below and diff before
recommitting.

## let-it-be (standalone song, ADR0017)

Generated by `tectonic let-it-be.tex` against the pinned songs pack. The
method documented under "Shared setup" below reproduces the committed
`let-it-be-reference.txt` byte-for-byte (validated 2026-11-01), so one
procedure covers both fixtures.

## demo-book (multi-song book with a title index, ADR0019)

The songs package's index pipeline is a three-step flow that a single TeX
pass cannot complete: LaTeX pass 1 writes `<index>.sxd` data files, the
external `songidx` step converts one into `<index>.sbx`, and a later LaTeX
pass typesets the real index entries. The reference therefore needs two
tectonic invocations with the pinned `songidx.lua` in between — exactly the
sequence the PDF worker reproduces in the browser (engine compile →
`songbook-core::songidx` conversion → engine recompile). The committed
`demo-book-reference.txt` was generated with these commands inside a
throwaway `songbook-devcontainer:latest` container:

```sh
docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/workspace -w /workspace songbook-devcontainer:latest
```

```sh
# inside the container (repo mounted at /workspace)
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y texlive-binaries   # texlua
W=/tmp/native && rm -rf "$W" && mkdir -p "$W/bundle"
tar -xzf /workspace/web/dist/pdf-assets/engine/bundle.tar.gz -C "$W/bundle"
tar -xzf /workspace/web/dist/pdf-assets/pack/pack.tar.gz     -C "$W/bundle"
# tectonic's directory bundle needs a SHA256SUM manifest (and it must not
# list itself): generate it after both extractions.
( cd "$W/bundle" &&
  find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUM | sed 's|^\./||' | LC_ALL=C sort |
  xargs sha256sum > /tmp/SHA256SUM.tmp && mv /tmp/SHA256SUM.tmp SHA256SUM )
unzip -p /workspace/web/pdf/.cache/songs.zip songs/songidx/songidx.lua > "$W/songidx.lua"
cd "$W" && cp /workspace/web/pdf/test/fixtures/demo-book.tex .

# step 1: tectonic's internal passes; the index renders the package's
#         placeholder and the run keeps titleidx.sxd
tectonic -b "$W/bundle" -f latex.fmt --keep-intermediates demo-book.tex

# step 2: the external songidx conversion (same interpreter and locale the
#         songidx goldens in crates/songbook-core use)
LC_ALL=C texlua songidx.lua titleidx.sxd titleidx.sbx

# step 3: recompile; this run typesets the real index entries
tectonic -b "$W/bundle" -f latex.fmt --keep-intermediates demo-book.tex
```

then on the host (so the reference is extracted with the same pdftotext the
smoke uses):

```sh
pdftotext <container's demo-book.pdf> web/pdf/test/fixtures/demo-book-reference.txt
```

## Shared setup notes

- **TeX inputs**: the compile uses the engine's own pinned bundle
  (`engine/bundle.tar.gz`, which carries the prebuilt `latex.fmt`) plus the
  pinned pack (`pack/pack.tar.gz`) extracted **over** it, mirroring the
  browser engine's `addFiles` order (bundle first, pack wins — 25 of the 38
  overlapping BaKoMa font files differ between the two). `-f latex.fmt` is
  required because the bundle stores the format prebuilt under that name;
  plain `-f latex` makes native tectonic try to generate a format from a
  `tectonic-format-latex.tex` file this bundle does not carry.
- **Interpreter**: `texlua` (LuaTeX 1.15.0, TeX Live 2022 as packaged in
  Debian 12) — the interpreter the songs package documentation prescribes,
  which supplies the `unicode.utf8` library `songidx.lua` depends on.
- **Locale**: `LC_ALL=C`, so songidx's `strcoll` comparisons are plain byte
  order — the same order the `songbook-core::songidx` port hard-codes.
- **Keeping intermediates**: `--keep-intermediates` leaves `titleidx.sxd`
  (and `demo-book.sxc`) next to the source after step 1; step 3 rewrites the
  same `.sxd` (the index data does not depend on the typeset pages).

## demo-book-reference.txt stats (as committed 2026-11-01)

- 1016 bytes, 4 pages (title, index, 2 song pages), LF line endings.
- Page 2 is the real sorted index (`Every Construct` before `Let It Be`),
  not the package's "Index not yet generated" placeholder.
